notes: Original renames seven space-containing column names (from a public NY State Retail Food Stores CSV) using SAS name-literal ('name'n) syntax, then runs PROC FREQ on county and square_footage and PROC MEANS on square_footage; PROC IMPORT of the local Retail_Food_Stores.csv path was replaced with a 20-row inline DATALINES sample carrying the same seven fields, renamed via a RENAME= dataset option to the original space-containing names so the 'name'n rename block runs unmodified.
